intent_snapshot.goal: Open exactly one PR from retained imm/<slug> for a completed daemon Initiative batch whose final verification passed, gated on the batch commit and every child's .imm/audit/ evidence digest through batchDeliveryEvidence, idempotent on repeated E13, with single-task delivery unchanged and the ULS Spec D13 amendment recorded in the new Spec, per D3 of docs/specs/loop-leader-uls-alignment.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-DEC-A1, BR-SCN-A1; meet D3.1-D3.3 in docs/specs/loop-leader-uls-alignment.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-daemon-drive-pr.test.ts. Done looks like: a completed Initiative batch with passing final verification opens one PR whose head is imm/<slug> and whose body lists every child's acceptance IDs and audit digest; imm-loop status shows the item in review. Negative: a child without audit evidence, a failed or missing final verification result, or a batch not in completed state opens no PR and records the named reason; a repeated E13 for the same batch opens no second PR; single-task PR creation from refs/heads/imm/<task_id> is unchanged.

intent_snapshot.scope_size_reason: The aggregated delivery evidence and the open_pr branch that consumes it are one gate; neither is observable alone.

acceptance_results.summary: host-attested QA: all 2 project verification check(s) passed; execution=sha256:1c1932cac1a5a86a9c9f6665a86f995f63f2fb4bb6181ec37b91c6daf8670bc8

attestations.summary: S3-AC1 met: batchDeliveryEvidence fails closed on non-completed, missing/failed final verification, missing retained branch, unintegrated child and missing audit pair; open_pr routes Initiative WorkItems to one imm/<slug> PR listing acceptance ids and audit digests, repeated E13 upserts the existing PR, single-task path untouched; antigravity runtime mirror identical, dist diffs are bundler createHash renames only. Blast radius: medium — loop_daemon/dispatch.ts open_pr handler and unattended/batch_preflight.ts, no persisted shape change.

advisory_findings.summary: The gate verifies record.branch, but the PR head is derived from the slug, so the two could diverge.

evidence.trigger: A v3 batch record whose branch field is set to something other than imm/<initiative_slug>: batchDeliveryEvidence checks that branch contains the commit, but openLoopPullRequest builds its head from prBranchName(evidence.slug), so the PR head is a branch the gate never checked

advisory_findings.summary: The Initiative PR risk is the first non-routine child risk, not the highest one, and the single-task test only covers the refusal path.

evidence.trigger: Children with risks [low, material] give risk=low; this only changes the PR body risk text because draft is risk!==routine either way. Separately, the 'keeps single-task delivery' test only asserts a failed refusal, not a successful single-task PR
